newsitem.title: UK: Reuters to launch new forex product.
newsitem.headline: Reuters to launch new forex product.

text.p: Global news and information company Reuters Holdings Plc said on Tuesday it will launch an advanced trading product for the foreign exchange forwards market on June 9.
The product, Dealing 2000-2 Forwards, will be an extension of Dealing 2000-2, Reuters' automated matching service for the spot market which is currently used by many foreign exchange dealers.
Reuters said Dealing 2000-2 Forwards would allow dealers to post live bids and match deals electronically for periods from "tomorrow/next" to one year.
As with the spot product, Reuters will act as a broker in the wholesale interbank market, the company said in a statement.
The new product has been tested with clients in the UK, U.S., Germany, France and Switzerland.
Existing Dealing 2000-2 users will not require any new client site communications equipment for forwards matching.
"They will be able to trade seamlessly between spot and forwards on the same screen, customising the number of spot and forwards lines," Reuters said.
Reuters will initially list dollar/mark forward swaps but expects to add other currency pairs in due course.
"Reuters is extending Dealing 2000-2 to forwards in response to customer demand. Reaction to testing has been very positive," Rosalyn Wilton, managing director, transaction products, said.
Reuters created the electronic matching market in spot foreign exchange five years ago when it launched Dealing 2000-2.
The service provided clients with greater liquidity and reduced brokerage costs.
"Extending the advantages of automated dealing to the forwards market was a logical step for us," Wilton added.
